name: Activation-Informed Coarse-to-Fine Rendering
definition: A rendering optimization that skips the expensive fine-pass evaluation of the NeRF MLP for rays that are determined to be empty or background, based on intermediate activation values from the coarse pass.
summary: Activation-Informed Coarse-to-Fine Rendering accelerates NeRF inference by using intermediate network activations to selectively skip the expensive fine pass for background rays.
